title: What “Total Value Locked” (TVL) Means
summary: Total value locked is the amount of assets currently deposited in a DeFi protocol — a rough gauge of how much people are using and trusting it.
blocks: Total value locked is the amount of assets currently deposited in a DeFi protocol — a rough gauge of how much people are using and trusting it.
A higher TVL suggests more activity and liquidity, which is why it is often used to compare the size of different protocols.
It is only one measure and can move sharply with prices and incentives, so it describes scale rather than safety or quality.
